ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager walks to a favorite thinking rock at the end of the beach and finds someone already sitting on it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everyone needs somewhere to think. For (subject) it's a flat rock at the end of the beach, where the waves are loud enough to drown out everything else. Today (subject.he/she) walks all the way there and finds (friend) sitting on it.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "Mind if I sit?" asks (subject). (friend) shifts over. Neither says anything for a long time. It turns out a good thinking rock is big enough for two, as long as both of them are quiet.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) wanders back along the shore and finds a tree with a low, curving branch that fits (subject.him/her) perfectly. It's not the rock. But the shade is lovely, and the sea sounds just as loud from here. (subject.He/She) might come back tomorrow.
